# SD18 deterministic Human Wizard level 16 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Wizard
# level-1..level-15 prepared arcane spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/sd18_wizard_level15_widening.rs) to Wizard level 16 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat posture from
# the level-1..level-15 fixtures, and the same canonical school
# specialization selections (Evocation chosen, Necromancy/Transmutation
# opposed), adding only the level bump this cycle needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Wizard burden surface: no evocation
# spell-damage application, no force-missile casting execution, no
# opposed-school preparation cost, no spellbook, no spells prepared, no spell
# slots, no spell DCs, no bonus-feat selection/execution for the
# still-unproven 5th/10th/15th-level "Bonus feat" grants, and no level-17+
# progression. Two PF1 CRB primary sources (d20pfsrd and the Archives of
# Nethys aonprd.com mirror) were read directly before writing this fixture,
# and both agree byte-for-byte: base attack bonus GENUINELY RISES to +8
# (`16/2 = 8`, up from +7) and good Will GENUINELY RISES to +10
# (`16/2+2 = 10`, up from +9), while poor Fortitude/Reflex both STAY at +5
# (`16/3 = 5`, an integer-division coincidence with level 15).
# The raw Wizard spells-per-day table's level-16 row is
# "4/4/4/4/4/4/3/3/2" — up from the level-15 row "4/4/4/4/4/4/3/2/1" (the
# 7th-level column rises from 2 to 3 and the 8th-level column rises from 1
# to 2); the 9th-level column STAYS "—" (9th-level wizard spells do not
# become available until wizard level 17), so no genuinely new spell-level
# column opens and the specialist bonus-slot flat count (one bonus slot of
# each spell level she can cast, 1st through 8th) STAYS at 8, unchanged from
# level 15. Intense Spells' bonus-damage magnitude GENUINELY RISES to 8
# (`max(16/2, 1) = 8`, up from 7) via the pre-existing formula, not
# re-derived; Force Missile's uses-per-day pool stays level-independent and
# unchanged; Scribe Scroll stays recognized as an already-held grant.
# The level-16 "Special" column is genuinely BLANK on both primary sources
# (the Wizard's own next bonus feat lands at 20th level) — a pure ceiling
# raise, no new pillar record is grounded at level 16.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-wizard-level16-sd18-widening
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:wizard:16
ability=strength:8
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:17
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:wizard_school_specialization:school:evocation
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:necromancy
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:transmutation
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:intelligence
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
